packageRules.description: Verify pnpm artifacts with the workspace packing hook before merging npm updates.
prBodyNotes: This workspace uses a pnpm packing hook that hosted Renovate skips. If the lockfile drops `pnpmfileChecksum` or artifact generation fails, follow [the dependency update workflow](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-export/blob/main/development_docs/development.md#review-dependency-updates): regenerate with `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile`, verify `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, and run `make check`. Keep the 14-day release cooldown intact.
